opening.argument: The video centers on reviewing Panera's menu and nutrition information with viewers: the speaker says, “we can go through the menu together, go through the nutrition together,” and explains, “I am simply reading the nutrition to you and and going through it to go with you.” That framing supports an ordinary educational purpose of helping viewers make informed dietary choices. The stated aim is also to “bring awareness to what's actually out there,” with no connection between viewer engagement and payment, private data, or promised returns.
